children.value: imaṃ tāvatkṣaṇaṃ jātaṃ saṃśayaṃ me nivāraya
videhamukto na kathaṃ kathaṃ muktaḥ suto'sya saḥ

ātyantikaduḥkho-muktireva jñānaphalaṃ taccetsarvajñasyāpi vyāsasya na saṃpannaṃ
jñāsyā-nityaphalatvaṃ prāptam

kiṃca yadi jñānenājñānaṃ
niḥśeṣamucchinna tarhi bhṛgvādivajjīvanāsaṃbhavaḥ upādānanāśe
kāryāvasthānāyogāt ajīvane ca
brahmavidyāpravartakābhāvātsaṃpradāyocchedaḥ
utpatyotpatya līnā ye na saṃkhyāmupayānti te
śakyante tāśca saṃkhyātuṃ naiva kāścana kenacit
tāṃśca vai parisaṃkhyātuṃ sā kathaiva na vidyate
tāsāṃ vicāraṇā yuktā vartamānāstu kā iva
evaṃ mṛtā mriyante ca mariṣyanti ca koṭayaḥ
paraṃ lokaṃ kalpayati mṛtastatra tathā punaḥ
vāsanāyā antaḥ antare anye puruṣā dehāḥ
puruṣā iti paśvādīnāmapyupana pṛthvyādimahābhūtagaṇā na ca jagatkramāḥ

alpadhiyo brahmavidbrahmavidvaro
brahmavidvarīyān brahmavidvariṣṭha iti prasiddheṣu caturthasthānāviśrānteralpaadyāpyanye bhaviṣyanti vyāsavālmīkayastathā
sa evānyaśca lokāśca tvaṃ cāhaṃ ceti vedmyaham
brāhmī brāhmakalpāvayavabhūtā tretā sāṃpratamasti pratikalpaṃ cāsīd25
brahmatvaṃ ca tathā kṛtvā bhāvyaṃ vaidehamokṣaṇam
samāni santi bhūtāni kadācinnatu tāni tu
